risks.title: Dependence on artisanal skills and excellence craftsmanship
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned centrally in Item 1A (Talent section). Moderate intensity language but repeated ("excellence craftsmanship", "expertise", "passing on"). Stable trend but with growing defensive actions (IME, AME, La Maison des Métiers). High category weight: 213k employees, 75 Houses, critical generational transmission.

risks.title: Ethical compliance and anti-corruption in the supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly named at the opening of Item 1A ("fight against corruption", "money laundering", "human rights"). High intensity language with repetitions ("compliance failures", "corrective measures"). Upward trend: Code of Conduct revision in 2023, 2,021 supplier audits in 2023, geographic expansion of the program. Major category weight for international group.

risks.title: Environmental risk management and LIFE 360 compliance
risks.score_rationale: Major environmental risk detailed at end of Item 1A (Environment section). Moderate intensity language but with ambitious quantified targets (20% footprint reduction 2026, 30% water 2030). Upward trend: new programs (Gaia center, LIFE Academy, LVMH Circularity). Critical category weight for luxury/fashion sector.

risks.title: Reputation risks related to diversity, inclusion and workers' rights
risks.score_rationale: Explicit reputation risk in Item 1A (Talent section: "diverse societies", "unconscious bias", "equal opportunity"). Moderate intensity language but with public targets (50% women in key positions 2025, 2% disabled 2025). Stable trend with defensive actions (80k employees bias training, EllesVMH). Medium-high category weight for luxury brands.

risks.title: Dependence on critical natural resources and supply volatility
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in Item 1A (Environment and Talent sections: water, materials, cocoa, essential oils). Moderate intensity language ("water stress", "biodiversity", "regenerative agriculture"). Upward trend: new agroforestry programs (Turkey, Chad, Australia, Indonesia). High category weight for Wines & Spirits, Perfumes & Cosmetics.

risks.title: Health and safety compliance risks and workplace safety across 81 countries
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 1A (Talent section: "Health & Safety Charter", "zero-accident culture"). Moderate intensity language with 2025 targets (100% of 5 commitments). Stable trend: 86% of Houses H&S approach, 96% periodic reviews, 92% Management Committees. Medium category weight for 213k employee group.

risks.title: Traceability risks and fraud in strategic materials supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in Item 1A (Environment section: "traceability target", "country of origin", "diamonds", "leather"). Moderate intensity language (96-99% traceability achieved). Stable trend with reinforcement (LVMH Circularity, Nona Source, CEDRE, WeTurn). Medium category weight for luxury sector.

risks.title: Talent retention and mobility risks in complex 75-House ecosystem
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk in Item 1A (Talent section: "career mobility", "18,000 employees changed positions"). Moderate intensity language but with key figures (18k mobility moves 2023, 260k Inside LVMH accounts). Stable trend with defensive actions (Game Changers Together, Leading for Future). Medium-high category weight for 213k employee group.
